title: RJ Mitte, Who Played Walter White’s Son on ‘Breaking Bad,’ Dies at 34
summary: Mr. Mitte was born with cerebral palsy and brought his own experience of living with the disability to the role of Walter White Jr. on the Emmy-winning show.
